package main

import (
	"os"

	"github.com/redpanda-data/ai-sdk-go/catalog"
	"github.com/redpanda-data/ai-sdk-go/catalog/snapshot"
	"github.com/redpanda-data/ai-sdk-go/llm"
	"github.com/redpanda-data/ai-sdk-go/pricing"
)

const includeFlash = false
const inputRate = 1.40
const retires = ""
const structuredOutput = false

func main() {
	entry := func(id string, model catalog.ModelID) catalog.Entry {
		return catalog.Entry{
			ID: id, Model: model,
			Capabilities: llm.ModelCapabilities{Streaming: true, StructuredOutput: structuredOutput},
			Constraints: llm.ModelConstraints{MaxInputTokens: 1000, MaxOutputTokens: 100},
			WireAPIs: []catalog.WireAPI{{Protocol: catalog.WireProtocolOpenAIChatCompletions, Transport: catalog.WireTransportDirect}},
			Pricing: pricing.FlatInfo(inputRate, 4.40, .26),
			Life: catalog.Lifecycle{Stage: catalog.StageGA},
		}
	}
	glm := entry("accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3", "zai/glm-5.3")
	if retires != "" {
		glm.Life.Retires = catalog.MustDate(retires)
	}
	entries := []catalog.Entry{glm}
	if includeFlash {
		entries = append(entries, entry("accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3-flash", "zai/glm-5.3-flash"))
	}
	registry := catalog.Registry{
		"zai/glm-5.3": {Publisher: "zai", DisplayName: "GLM", Series: "glm", Released: catalog.MustDate("2026-08-14")},
		"zai/glm-5.3-flash": {Publisher: "zai", DisplayName: "GLM Flash", Series: "glm-flash", Released: catalog.MustDate("2026-08-26")},
	}
	if err := snapshot.Encode(os.Stdout, catalog.MustNew("fireworks", entries, catalog.WithRegistry(registry))); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
